title: Tag chips input
when: The user wants a field where typed words become removable chips, such as tags, skills, emails or keywords.
prompt:
Goal: A chips field that adds on Enter or comma, removes by button or Backspace, and submits the values with the form.
Steps:
1. A <label for="tag-input">, a <ul aria-label="Selected tags"> of chips, each with its text and <button type="button" aria-label="Remove tag design">, then the text input.
2. Enter or comma adds the trimmed value; ignore empty values and case insensitive duplicates; enforce max length and count with a message.
3. Backspace in an empty input moves focus to the last chip remove button instead of deleting at once.
4. After removing a chip, focus the next chip or the input.
5. Keep <input type="hidden" name="tags"> in sync with the values joined by commas.
6. Announce Tag design added or removed in role="status"; build chips with createElement and textContent.
Quality bar:
- Chips wrap onto new lines at 375 px.
- Paste of a comma list adds several chips.
- The field looks like one input.
Pitfalls:
- Chips inserted with innerHTML from what the user typed.
- Backspace that deletes chips by accident.
- Values that never reach the form submit.
Verify:
- [ ] The text input has a label.
- [ ] Remove buttons name their chip.
- [ ] The hidden field holds every value.
- [ ] Adds and removals are announced.
Output: Field markup, chips.css and chips.js.

examples.input: campo de habilidades que vira etiquetas ao apertar enter
examples.output: label Skills, chip list with Remove buttons, Enter and comma add, hidden input skills=css,js
